agent_discovery.description: Locate the most distal visible point of the current robot effector, mounted tool, or held tool that still has reliable registered-depth evidence. Native camera geometry is returned only as explicit camera_system_x/y/z optical coordinates; transformed target points carry convention provenance. This is general alignment evidence, not a task-specific action point.
when_to_use: A stationary alignment or registration task needs the general front reference of the visible effector assembly.
A reflective or thin tool tip has missing depth and the most distal reliable point on the same rigid tool body is needed.
A bare two-jaw gripper needs both front points registered before their 3D average is used.
when_not_to_use: The task needs a drill tip, hammer face, cutting edge, nozzle, or another task-specific action point.
The effector or held tool is moving relative to the captured frame.
The result would be treated as motion authorization or a published control frame.
side_effects: Reads one synchronized RGB and registered-depth frame plus timestamped transform evidence.
Calls one configured VLM route with bounded backend fallback.
Returns read-only point evidence and does not command or authorize motion.

target_frame.description: Calibrated target frame in which to return the registered front reference.
